contractVersion.description: Version of the Rule Set format. This schema implements 1.0.1 and accepts 1.0.x.

version.description: Version of this rule content (semver; bump rules in CONTRACT.md §3).

compiledAt.description: Compile time, ISO 8601 in UTC (suffix Z).

compilerVersion.description: Version of the lsc build that produced the file.

path.description: Skill file path, relative to the Skill directory, with forward slashes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file bytes, lowercase hex.

fileMatchers.description: Glob patterns (forward slashes, relative to the repository root) of files the Rule Set applies to.

lineComment.description: Line comment marker; the comment runs to end of line.

blockComment.description: Block comment start and end markers (not nested).

stringDelimiters.description: String literal delimiters. No escape sequences in contract 1.0.

rules.description: The rules. Only rules with status validated are applied.

description: Language Skill Compiler Rule Set: the contract with Legacy Navigator.

Rule.description: One deterministic rule. `engine` selects which engine configuration is present.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique within the Rule Set.

blockEnd.description: Closes the scope opened by this definition (D4). Only on module_declaration and symbol_definition.

searchStrings.description: Default false. true: the rule also matches inside string literals (strings are not masked for it).

confidence.description: Computed by the fixed formula in docs/PLAN.md §6.3 (D8); never model-assigned.

status.description: Only validated rules are exported; consumers must ignore rejected rules.

ExactRule.description: Rule using the exact (token sequence) engine.

RuleType.description: What the rule detects; determines the Navigator record (see RULE_TYPE_SPEC).

tokens.description: Token sequence matched on one line. A token written exactly as (?<name>) is a capture placeholder.

caseSensitive.description: false: literal tokens match case-insensitively (RE2 flag i).

Captures.description: Capture role → named group in the pattern (or placeholder in exact tokens). Must include the roles required by the rule type.

CaptureRole.description: Role of a captured value; allowed roles depend on the rule type.

pattern.description: RE2-compatible pattern (D3). Named groups use the (?<name>...) form (D2).

flags.description: Subset of "ims" in that order: i case-insensitive, m ^/$ at line breaks, s dot matches newline.

multiline.description: false: applied to each line separately; true: applied to the whole file text.

skill.description: Skill file path, relative to the Skill directory, with forward slashes.

anchor.description: Section anchor (heading slug) inside the Skill file.

exampleIds.description: IDs of the examples that justify the rule.

SourceEvidence.description: Provenance: where the rule comes from.

passed.description: Examples passed in the last validation.

failed.description: Examples failed in the last validation.

RuleTests.description: Result of the last validation run (docs/PLAN.md §6.2).
